eSpeak-NG JavaScript/WebAssembly distribution

Package: espeak-ng 1.0.2
Package registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/espeak-ng
Upstream JavaScript/Emscripten wrapper: https://github.com/ianmarmour/espeak-ng.js
Upstream eSpeak-NG speech synthesizer: https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng
License: GPL-3.0-or-later (see ESPEAK-LICENSE.txt)

The extension includes the package's dist/espeak-ng.js and dist/espeak-ng.wasm
without modifying their contents. The WASM distribution embeds the eSpeak-NG
data files, including Russian voice data. It is run locally in an extension
module worker to synthesize WAV audio; it does not use a remote service.
